description: 进度落后时，最难的不是道歉，而是把坏消息说清楚、给出选项、重新对齐预期。

targetChunks.en: I wanted to give you a heads-up.
targetChunks.note: heads-up = 提前告知；比 I have bad news 更专业，也给对方心理准备。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I wanted to give you a heads-up before the client call.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 客户电话前，先跟你打个招呼。

targetChunks.note: behind schedule 是最标准的项目延期说法；不要绕成 We are a little late。
targetChunks.exampleEn: We're behind schedule by about a week.

targetChunks.en: We've hit a bit of a snag.
targetChunks.note: snag = 意外障碍，比 problem 轻；a bit of 让坏消息没那么重。
targetChunks.exampleEn: We've hit a bit of a snag with the API integration.
targetChunks.exampleZh: API 对接上遇到点小麻烦。

targetChunks.en: It's turned out to be more involved than we thought.
targetChunks.note: involved = 牵扯多、复杂；比 difficult 更专业，也更像复盘语气。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It's turned out to be more involved than we thought.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 这事比我们预想的复杂。

targetChunks.note: realistic 是关键；逼对方给可执行的日期，而不是乐观估计。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Forget the original plan — what's the realistic timeline?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 先别管原计划，现实的时间线是什么？

targetChunks.en: Can we push the deadline back by a week?
targetChunks.zh: 能把截止日期往后推一周吗？
targetChunks.note: push back by + 时间；比 delay the deadline 更自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can we push the deadline back by a week without losing the launch window?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 在不影响上线窗口的前提下，能把截止日期推后一周吗？

targetChunks.note: deprioritize 是职场高频词；把「延期」转成「范围取舍」。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What can we deprioritize to protect the core launch?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 为了保住核心上线，哪些可以往后放？

targetChunks.note: overcommit = 承诺超出能力；比 I can't promise 更专业。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I don't want to overcommit and miss the date again.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不想承诺过多，然后又错过日期。

targetChunks.note: 会议里把敏感或太细的话题挪出公开讨论；高频。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's take this offline and look at the resourcing.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 这个私下聊，看看人力怎么调。

targetChunks.en: I'll keep you in the loop.
targetChunks.note: in the loop = 在信息循环里；比 tell you 更职场。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll keep you in the loop as soon as we hear back.

targetChunks.note: touch base = 简短沟通；比 have a meeting 更轻。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's touch base on Friday and see where we are.

targetChunks.note: bear with us = 请耐心等待；客服和项目沟通都很常用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Thanks for bearing with us while we sort this out.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 谢谢你在我们处理期间耐心等待。

roleplay.promptZh: 项目要延期一周，你需要向经理说明原因、给出现实时间线、提出范围取舍，并约定后续同步。
roleplay.promptEn: The project will slip by a week. Tell your manager, give a realistic timeline, propose scope trade-offs, and agree on follow-up.
goals: 用 heads-up 开场，先给心理准备
把「延期」转成「时间/范围」的具体选项

script.speaker: you
script.en: I wanted to give you a heads-up — we're behind schedule.
script.zh: 先跟你说一声，我们进度落后了。

script.speaker: you
script.en: We've hit a snag with the API. It's more involved than we thought.
script.zh: API 那边遇到点麻烦，比我们预想的复杂。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Can we push the deadline back by a week? We could also deprioritize the analytics dashboard.
script.zh: 能把截止日期推后一周吗？我们也可以把分析看板往后放。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Let's take this offline and look at scope.
script.zh: 这个私下聊，看看范围怎么调。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sounds good. I'll keep you in the loop and we can touch base on Friday.
script.zh: 好，我随时同步，周五再对一下。
